edits.new:
Then the inbox holds the event ID once and the duplicate is ignored

  Scenario: AC9 The timeline shows the hub's documents without a copy (new, D-RCV-60)
    When the case timeline of "RW-2026-000501" is read through GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/{caseId}/timeline
    Then each document item of the timeline is composed from the document hub's read for "DOC-0501-01"
    Then this service writes no document item and no document row in rwb_case

  Scenario: AC10 No personal data enters the task, the record or a log line (new, D-RCV-60)
    When the task of AC6 is raised for case "RW-2026-000501" from a capture that carries a position, a file name and a bill value
    Then the task, the decision-record entry and the log lines carry the case, the missing type code, the checklist version and the task reference only
    Then no position, file name, bill value or photo appears in them and the case context carries no customer field

  Scenario: AC11 A call without a valid caller or entitlement is answered 401 or 403 (new, D-RCV-60)
    When a caller with no token reads GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/{caseId} for case "RW-2026-000501"
    Then the answer is 401 as an RFC 9457 problem response naming the request
    When "FC-01" with a role that does not carry Documents "C" reads GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/{caseId}/timeline for case "RW-2026-000501"
    Then the answer is 403 with message MSG-P4-002 and no case data is returned

  Scenario: AC12 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is queued for retry (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-access authorise call does not answer
    When "FC-01" reads GET /api/recovery/case/v1/cases/{caseId} for case "RW-2026-000501"
    Then the answer carries message MSG-GEN-006 with the system "rwb-access" and the request is queued and will be retried
    Then no case data is returned and no task is raised
